claim: PubMed is an external free search and retrieval resource for biomedical and life-sciences literature citations and abstracts, with links to full text where available.
future_grounding_route: Specific papers found through PubMed can be used only as external context or queued for data-grounding if they point to reachable datasets.
project_use: Public MS literature navigation and prior-art discovery.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Broad biomedical citation/abstract search across MEDLINE, life-science journals, and online books.
why_unverifiable: PubMed's literature indexing and citation corpus are externally curated and not rerunnable from this repository.
